_metadata.description: Filing-specific rules per state: frequencies, due dates, zero-return requirements, registration details.

rules.frequency_assignment_method: CDTFA assigns based on estimated tax liability. Generally quarterly for new registrants, may move to monthly if >$50,000/yr tax or annually if very low volume.
rules.due_date_notes: Quarterly returns due last day of the month following the quarter end (April 30, July 31, October 31, January 31). Prepayment required for taxpayers averaging $17,000+/month.
rules.zero_return_notes: Must file even if no tax is due in a period. Failure to file zero returns can result in estimated assessments.
rules.prepayment_notes: Required if average monthly tax exceeds ~$17,000. Most small FBA sellers will not trigger prepayment.
rules.registration_notes: Apply for a seller's permit through CDTFA. Separate FTB registration for franchise tax (Form 568). Two different agencies, two registrations.

rules.frequency_assignment_method: Comptroller assigns based on estimated tax. Quarterly is typical for new filers. May be monthly if tax > ~$1,500/quarter or annually if < ~$1,000/year.
rules.due_date_notes: Returns due the 20th of the month following the reporting period. Quarterly: April 20, July 20, October 20, January 20.
rules.zero_return_notes: Must file zero returns. Failure to file results in estimated assessments. Can file online via Webfile.
rules.prepayment_notes: Required if tax collected in any quarter of the prior year exceeded $50,000. Very unlikely for most FBA sellers where Amazon handles collection.
rules.discount_notes: 0.5% timely filing discount (1.75% for prepayers). Maximum $2,500/reporting period.
rules.registration_notes: Apply for a sales tax permit through the Comptroller. Separate franchise tax registration through the Comptroller's franchise tax division. WebFile system handles both.

primary_sources.citation: TX Comptroller sales tax filing guide

rules.frequency_assignment_method: PA DOR typically assigns monthly for new registrants. Semi-annual and annual options exist for very low volume.
rules.due_date_notes: Returns due the 20th of the month following the reporting period.
rules.zero_return_notes: Must file zero returns. PA uses e-TIDES online filing system.
rules.discount_notes: 1% timely filing discount on first $300 of tax due (max $25/month).
rules.registration_notes: Register online through PA DOR. Separate registration for corporate net income tax if applicable.

rules.frequency_assignment_method: NYDTF typically assigns quarterly for most new registrants. Monthly filing for larger sellers. Annual filing available for vendors with less than $3,000 tax per quarter.
rules.due_date_notes: Quarterly returns due March 20, June 20, September 20, December 20 (note: not the 20th of the following month — NY quarters end Feb/May/Aug/Nov). Annual due March 20.
rules.zero_return_notes: Must file zero returns quarterly. Use Online Tax Center.
rules.prepayment_notes: PrompTax required for vendors with $300,000+ in annual taxable sales in certain areas.
rules.registration_notes: Register for a Certificate of Authority through NYDTF. Process is online through the Online Tax Center.
rules.notes: NY has unusual quarterly periods (Mar 1 - May 31, Jun 1 - Aug 31, Sep 1 - Nov 30, Dec 1 - Feb 28/29). This catches many sellers off guard.

rules.frequency_assignment_method: FL DOR assigns monthly for most. Quarterly for sellers with <$1,000/year tax. Semi-annual for very low volume.
rules.due_date_notes: Returns due the 20th of the month following the collection period. Returns filed and paid electronically by the 20th receive a collection allowance.
rules.zero_return_notes: Must file even with no tax due. Failure to file results in $50 late filing penalty.
rules.discount_notes: 2.5% collection allowance on first $1,200 of tax due (max $30/period for monthly filers).
rules.registration_notes: Register through FL DOR online portal. No state income tax — sales tax only.

rules.frequency_assignment_method: Monthly if estimated annual tax > $500. Quarterly if < $500.
rules.due_date_notes: Monthly returns due the 20th of the following month. Quarterly returns due the 20th of the month following the quarter end.

rules.frequency_assignment_method: DOR assigns based on estimated tax. Monthly if annual tax > $4,800. Quarterly if $1,200-$4,800. Annual if < $1,200.
rules.due_date_notes: Returns due the 25th of the month following the reporting period. Combined excise tax return covers both sales tax and B&O tax.
rules.zero_return_notes: Must file zero returns. Combined filing covers sales tax + B&O tax on one return.
rules.registration_notes: Register through WA DOR Business Licensing Service. Single registration covers both sales tax and B&O tax.
rules.notes: WA combined excise return covers both sales tax and B&O. This simplifies filing but sellers must remember to include B&O tax calculation, not just sales tax.
